propositions: The portability invariant's detection text must name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all' as distinct shapes in the Platform and venue matrix cell so that plans with only a specific CI trigger and no fallback can be flagged as non-portable.

A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g. GitHub Actions schedule alone) without an operation-linked or in-process fallback is not portable and must draw a project.portability finding naming the no-CI-provider alternate shape.

The authoritative rubric in .rebar/prompts/plan-review-project-portability.md must be mirrored exactly in docs/plan-review-gate.md and both must be pinned by their respective test modules to prevent silent drift.
AGENTS.md must surface the no-CI-provider rule as a one-line pointer to rebar explain project.portability and docs/plan-review-gate.md without restating rubric text.
Live A/B testing confirms that a plan with only a GitHub Actions compaction trigger and no fallback emits a project.portability finding under the new rubric but not under the old.
